title: The Drop of Marseille's old port
author: Casper Eastwick
blurb: Noor Eastwick, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
